prior_stage: L10-B5 saturated three-code graph with three probes; this stage tests budgets 1 or 2 for three unknown code-effect mappings.

development_conditions.public_structure: uniformly unknown bijective mapping of codes onto public effect channels; all six permutations are in the prior and all arms are informed of this constraint.
development_conditions.release_delay: Two subsequent time ticks; only legally matured effect events update memory.
development_conditions.bayes: Enumerates all 3! possible mappings, conditions on observed effect-code pairs, infers an unprobed effect only when every posterior-consistent map agrees. Query selection maximizes fit-graph expected full-coverage utility under the posterior; it is not an oracle for future CHECK graph distribution.
development_conditions.fit_check_source_access: Query selectors see only opaque DEV_FIT code-graph shapes and event consequences, no DEV_CHECK labels or L9/TEST heldout.

negative_conditions.feedback_withheld: Zero exact success and complete abstention for every method at either budget.
negative_conditions.feedback_permuted: Zero exact success at both budgets under systematically incorrect, but one-to-one, sensor consequences; classical and local outputs may be confidently wrong.
negative_conditions.limited_probe_check_distribution_shift: One-probe fixed-random 3/12 exceeds fit-expected-utility Bayesian design 1/12. No claimed out-of-sample design optimality.

scientific_interpretation.bounded_positive: Probes genuinely fewer than hidden codes. Local memory maintains and uses evidence acquired through delayed, content-addressed interventions, with no early feedback or protected source exposure.
scientific_interpretation.decisive_negative: A conventional exact Bayesian posterior using the same information and public bijection constraint correctly determines the third code after two probes, scoring 12/12, while local-only association scores 7/12 and abstains on five complete graphs. No novel state-acquisition or policy advantage.
scientific_interpretation.mechanism_diagnosis: Local learner fails to compose structural prior across known and unknown relations. Bayesian closure, not additional probe budget or hidden access, explains the accuracy gap.
limitations: Original code-effect mapping is bijective, stationary and only three symbols; no independent unfamiliar family.
Same DEV family classes used for fit and check; no meaningful world-model causal intervention transfer established.
The ground-truth consequence channel semantics and bijection prior are public, not learned from unsupervised cognition.
Inference cost and memory were instrumented per host but no full matched Pareto and no energy/FLOPs measurements.
Exact Bayesian query policy uses DEV_FIT graph shapes and can differ from optimum for unknown DEV_CHECK graph distribution.
Experiment does not claim human-language generalization, causal abstraction or adaptive transfer under changing dynamics.

next_gate: L10-B7 only if materially new causal hypothesis: introduce a genuinely non-bijective, state-dependent world requiring prediction under delayed interventions and interference; preregister separate independent development families and strong Bayesian/state-space comparators; protect L10 future first use and collect complete resource metrics. Do not tune the L10-B6 frozen outcomes.
